turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My book club wants to try a new format and I have to suggest one tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could all read different books on the same theme and then swap recommendations.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another idea is picking one very short book and reading it right there at the meeting.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we pick a book that was turned into a film, read it, and then watch the film together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The film night is the easiest sell, since people get a reward for finishing. Reading a short book at the meeting is cozy but might feel like school. The theme idea is great for variety but discussions can get scattered.
